name: multi_air_single_touch_pays_0p1_where_consecutive_pays_nothing
description: The car climbs at 45 degrees into a ball floating at (0, 0, 900) and hits it once (touch on frame 8, the only touch). Frame 8 is 8 steps = 0.533 s into the episode, past the 0.5 s start-up, the ball is above 150 and the car above 300, so MultiAirTouch counts it: the first-touch tier 0.1 (+5.0 at the v3 weight 50). ConsecutiveAirTouch pays nothing for a lone air touch. The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose (a ball set with exactly zero velocity in the air floats: see tools/reward_lab/README.md). Verified independently: a separate script that re-implements the touch counting (ball above 150, car above 300, 0.5 s spacing, 1.0 s timeout, ball landing reset) on the exported flags reproduces every Multi payment exactly. The car has no boost, so the boost multiplier removes every bonus and only the base tiers 0.1 / 0.4 / 0.7 are paid.

expect.intent: Multi pays the first-touch tier 0.1 for a lone air touch
Consecutive pays nothing for a lone air touch
